name: Talhindir's Autumn
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-08: The Haunted Corridor
description: All lights in the room snap on, just as Lyari remembers the day of her death. A susurrus of accusations and a guilty verdict fill the air. Ghostly elven warriors disappear and reappear in a disorienting and implacable advance.
disable: DC 18 Athletics to stand against the force of the verdict, or DC 18 Arcana , DC 18 Occultism , or DC 18 Religion to ritually disrupt the haunting. Each success reduces the haunt's actions by one When the haunt has no more actions, it is disabled and the Hunted by Chains haunt triggers.
reset: The haunt resets the next time the Soulshackle traps creatures in the library.
routine: (two actions) The haunt makes vengeful judgment Strikes against three different random creatures trapped in this haunt. A spectral pool of blood forms beneath any creature knocked Unconscious by this haunt.

defensiveAbilities.name: Accusations
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs all enter the room

Effect Accusations of crimes against the crown are whispered throughout the room in Elven. Each living creature in the room must attempt a DC 16 Will Saving Throw save or be Frightened 1. The haunt then rolls initiative.
